text.zh: 微信推送里冒出一批用 AI 洗稿的营销号：标题宏大、观点空洞、内容是 AI 拼凑的流水账，有的连 Markdown 的分割线、表格和代码符号都没清理就直接发了出来。作者截图吐槽，又让 GPT-5 对自己被拿去「代笔」点评了一番，文末推荐了一篇作者认为 AI 写得真正到位的文章。
text.en: WeChat keeps recommending marketing accounts that churn out AI-rewritten posts: a grand title, a hollow claim and an AI-stitched ramble, sometimes with the Markdown separators, tables and code fences still left in. The author collects screenshots of the worst, has GPT-5 comment on being used as their ghostwriter, and closes with one AI-written article the author thinks really works.
